source: https://wise.com/us/currency-converter/usd-to-gbp-rate/history (7-day stats), https://www.x-rates.com/average/?from=USD&to=GBP&amount=1&year=2026 (monthly averages), individual daily rates from search results for late July/early Aug 2026
note: Mid-market rate, fluctuates constantly. 30-day figures are compiled from monthly averages (July 2026 full month + August 2026 partial) plus individual daily data points, not a single clean rolling-30-day dataset - free public sources didn't expose one directly. Treat 30-day min/max as approximate.

last30Days.note: Low/high from daily data points seen for the period (e.g. 2026-07-29: 0.74798, 2026-08-02: 0.74104); average blends July's full-month average (0.7476) with August's partial-month average (0.7426).
